verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time [anytype-docs-20] and offer Markdown as an export format alongside Any-Block [anytype-docs-11]. That gives researchers an open, vendor-independent archive path. The pre-release API v2 also exposes objects as editable JSON documents [anytype-supp-api-versions], adding a documented JSON route to the data. Missing for 10: evidence that Any-Block is an openly documented JSON format, detail on how much survives Markdown export (properties, relations, types), a stable non-pre-release JSON export, and independent or hands-on confirmation of export quality.
